name: 性能监测 HUD
author: Artflow
description: 浮层性能 HUD：FPS（含 5s 最低值）、JS 堆、渲染进程与 GPU 进程内存（显存近似）、CPU；控件级卡顿归因（React 渲染按类型/控件实例、交互延迟按控件、隐藏排除法排查 GPU 类卡顿）；命令面板可开关

descriptionI18n.en: Overlay performance HUD: FPS (including the 5s low), JS heap, renderer and GPU process memory (VRAM approximation), and CPU usage; per-control jank attribution (React render by type/instance, interaction latency per control, and a hide-and-probe flow for GPU-bound jank); toggleable from the command palette.
